Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly extract the birthplace information from the Wikipedia page it was viewing. In Step 4, the agent explicitly stated that the Wikipedia page said Lewis Seiler "was born in Hollywood, Los Angeles." However, the text provided in the same turn clearly shows the Wikipedia infobox stating "Born: September 30, 1890, New York City, U.S." and the first sentence of the article stating "Seiler was born in New York City." The agent hallucinated or misread the content, reporting "Hollywood" instead of the clearly visible "New York City," which contradicted the actual source data presented in its own output. This error led to the false conclusion that there was a conflict between sources when, in reality, the Wikipedia source consistently supported New York City.
